page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8is.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated bare-metal enterprise server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It is driven by 128 dedicated vCPUs from Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. System memory capacity totals 1024.0 GB, providing an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio suited for large-scale dataset handling alongside computational processing.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by 8 integrated NVIDIA L20 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, offering a combined 384 GB of VRAM. High-speed networking is supported via a 170 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The server includes no local attached storage, relying on external network-attached block devices or cloud storage infrastructure for persistent data operations.

The combination of 8 discrete GPUs and 1 TB of system memory optimizes the server for hardware density in parallel compute tasks. The absence of local disk drives requires architectural reliance on network throughput for data ingestion, which is supported by the 170 Gbps network interface. Ideal workloads include artificial intelligence model training, large language model inference, computer vision, deep learning pipelines, and high-performance scientific computing.
